# HomeGuard

> > HomeGuard provides comprehensive home, termite, roof, and hazard inspection services throughout Northern and Southern California.

HomeGuard serves major California regions including Sacramento, Bay Area, Orange County, San Diego County, and Inland Empire with same-day inspection reports. The company offers specialized inspection services including sewer lateral, pool, and appliance assessments for residential properties.
